questions.prompt: Old age is rather talkative, although wisdom is greater.
questions.answer: Senectūs loquācior est, quamquam sapientia maior est.

questions.prompt: The very brave captive bore the punishment in silence.
questions.answer: Captīvus fortissimus poenam tacitus tulit.

questions.prompt: This omen seemed somewhat too dreadful to the frightened soldiers.
questions.answer: Hoc prōdigium mīlitibus territīs horribilius vīsum est.

questions.prompt: The town was more rich than brave.
questions.answer: Oppidum dītius quam fortius erat.

questions.prompt: The winter nights are rather long for the sleepless watchman.
questions.answer: Noctēs hībernae vigilī insomnī longiōrēs sunt.

questions.prompt: Speak as clearly as possible, so that all may understand.
questions.answer: Quam clārissimē loquere ut omnēs intellegant.

questions.prompt: The furious king was more cruel than just.
questions.answer: Rēx furibundus crūdēlior quam iūstior erat.

questions.prompt: A very faithful friend does not desert us in danger.
questions.answer: Amīcus fīdēlissimus in perīculō nōs nōn dēserit.

questions.prompt: That trouble was somewhat greater than we had expected.
questions.answer: Illa molestia maior fuit quam exspectāverāmus.

questions.prompt: March by as short a road as possible into the mountains.
questions.answer: Quam brevissimā viā in montēs contende.

questions.prompt: The very wise old man taught the boys many things.
questions.answer: Senex sapientissimus puerōs multa docuit.

questions.prompt: This wine is sweeter than that which you praised.
questions.answer: Hoc vīnum dulcius est quam id quod laudāvistī.

questions.prompt: Bring back as many captives as possible from the war.
questions.answer: Quam plūrimōs captīvōs ex bellō redūc.

questions.prompt: The leader's speech was rather too long for the weary troops.
questions.answer: Ōrātiō ducis mīlitibus fessīs longior fuit.

questions.prompt: A very manly courage shone in the young man's face.
questions.answer: Virtūs virīlissima in ōre iuvenis ēlūxit.

questions.prompt: The unexpected messenger delayed longer than was fitting.
questions.answer: Nūntius inexspectātus diūtius quam decēbat remorātus est.

questions.prompt: Build the wall as high as possible against the enemy.
questions.answer: Mūrum quam altissimum contrā hostēs exstrue.

questions.prompt: The shameless woman was more bold than beautiful.
questions.answer: Mulier impudīca audācior quam pulchrior erat.

questions.prompt: These bones seem older than the whole town.
questions.answer: Haec ossa tōtō oppidō antīquiōra vidēntur.

questions.prompt: Return home as quickly as possible, for danger threatens.
questions.answer: Quam celerrimē domum redī, nam perīculum imminet.
